title: Home Assistant · native cards and demo states
description: The actual Home Assistant frontend and the owner's original shutter and cleaner/media/kitchen cards. A fictional apartment replaces the floorplan, with controls repositioned for its rooms. Real clicks toggle a bulb, operate the native shutter sheet, start and dock the cleaner, and inspect the kitchen and media tabs. Every device state is synthetic. No real device commands or configuration changes.
sources: Read-only frontend assets and original custom dashboard components; configuration inputs remain private.
Fresh isolated browser with a local simulated WebSocket backend; no real credentials or live device states.
